name: Hide Pro Widgets for Elementor
author: oirmak1975

sections.description:
Hide Pro Widgets for Elementor is a lightweight and performance-friendly plugin developed for designers and web developers who use the free version of Elementor.

When designing with the free version, the locked “Pro” widgets constantly appear in the left panel, cluttering your workspace. This plugin completely hides those locked components, allowing you to design with a cleaner, more focused, and distraction-free interface.

  • Clean Interface: Removes locked, unusable components from the editor panel.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Does not add any extra load to your website; it only manipulates the editor interface.
  • Focused Workflow: Helps you make faster decisions by showing only the free and active components available to you.

This plugin was developed by Özer Irmak as a free contribution to the community.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or go to the WordPress dashboard, click “Add New -> Upload Plugin” and select the zip file.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Elementor editor, and you will see that the Pro widgets are automatically hidden. No extra settings are required.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin slow down my website?

Absolutely not. The plugin only runs within the WordPress admin dashboard and when the Elementor editor is active. It does not load any CSS or JavaScript files on the front-end (the side your visitors see).

Will the plugin break when Elementor is updated?

The plugin is built using standard hooks to ensure maximum compatibility. Unless Elementor makes a major core infrastructure change, it will not be affected by updates. In case of any issues, it will be quickly updated to the latest version.
